2026-09-22T09:31:12.3235121Z 
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3240142Z For multiple or complex arguments, pipe a JSON object on stdin using `.` as the sentinel:
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3246959Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3248245Z printf '{"item_number":42,"body":"### Title\n\nBody."}' | safeoutputs add_comment .
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3256531Z # or write to a file: safeoutputs create_pull_request . < /tmp/payload.json
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3258012Z ```
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3260603Z 
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3272465Z **Multi-line or long `body` content:** do NOT build the JSON payload with `printf`/`echo` embedding raw newlines or many escaped characters directly in the command line — the sandbox's shell command-injection guard may reject long or complex quoted arguments (reporting "expansion patterns"/"command substitution" even though none are present) and retrying the identical command will fail again. Instead, write the content to a temp file with a heredoc, then use `jq -Rs` to inject it as the `body` field:
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3279841Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3281385Z cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/gh-aw/body.md
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3282595Z Title
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3283041Z 
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3284166Z Multi-line body content goes here.
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3285455Z EOF
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3286918Z jq -Rs '{title: "My title", body: .}' /tmp/gh-aw/body.md | safeoutputs create_discussion .
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3289401Z ```
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3291709Z If a shell command is rejected for containing expansion patterns, do not retry the same command — switch to the heredoc + `jq -Rs` pattern above.
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3294078Z 
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3295559Z To inject an entire local file as the `body` field without re-embedding its content in the model context, use `jq -Rs`:
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3297790Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3298938Z jq -Rs --arg discussion_number "$DISCUSSION_NUMBER" \
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3300394Z   '{discussion_number: ($discussion_number|tonumber), body: .}' \
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3301698Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3303469Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3304762Z ```
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3308017Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
2026-09-22T09:31:12.3311333Z
